# BitGlow

> BitGlow is a web design studio in Salem, Oregon, run by developer Jesse Le Davis. It builds custom websites, online stores and booking tools for small businesses, and offers monthly care plans for hosting, updates and local SEO. Clients work directly with the developer.

## Services

- **Starter** ($900–1,200): 1–3 page mobile-friendly site with a contact or booking button, Google Business Profile cleanup and basic SEO. Good for restaurants, cafés and simple service businesses.
- **Standard** ($1,800–2,500): Up to 5 pages with a quote form, project gallery, Google reviews on the site, local SEO and Search Console setup. The most popular package.
- **Growth** ($3,500–5,000): 8–12 pages with a page per service and per area served, copywriting included and stronger local SEO.
- **Fix-up** ($400–900): Improvements to an existing site: listing mismatches, security, homepage rework and Google profile cleanup.
- **Online stores, booking systems and apps**: Custom quote.
- All projects are flat-priced, with 50% due to start and 50% before launch.

## Care Plans

- **Essentials** ($59/mo): Hosting, SSL, updates, daily backups, uptime monitoring, 30 minutes of edits per month.
- **Growth** ($119/mo): Everything in Essentials plus a monthly report, Google Business Profile check-up, 1.5 hours of edits and next-business-day response.
- **Local SEO Plus** ($249/mo): Everything in Growth plus monthly local SEO content, ranking tracking, 3 hours of edits and same-day urgent response.
- **Maintain Only** ($49/mo): For sites on the client's own host.
- Pay yearly for 2 months free. Month to month after the first 3 months. Clients own their site and domain and get a free full backup if they leave.

## Recent Work

- [Caneeli Designs](https://caneelidesigns.com): E-commerce site for a handcrafted goods artist with a custom admin panel for inventory, listings, and payments. Built with PHP, JavaScript, and Stripe.
- [Darren C Davis](https://darrencdavis.com): Speaker website for an author, former Fortune 100 executive, and nonprofit founder, with a keynote booking request form. Built with PHP and JavaScript.
